title: Apps That Pay You to Post on TikTok: Real Rates, Legit Options, and How to Spot Clickbait
summary: Compare apps that pay you to post on TikTok, from per-view CPV apps to TikTok Shop affiliate commissions and brand campaigns. See real rates, follower requirements, and how to tell legit offers from clickbait.
body_markdown:
## Payout Models Compared: Per-View, Flat Fee, Commission, and Rewards CPM


A quoted rate tells only part of the story. Per-view rewards depend on views that meet program rules, flat fees depend on completing an approved brief, and affiliate earnings depend on attributed purchases. Compare the conditions behind each payment before estimating what a post can earn.


It compares payout mechanics, not a promise: qualified-view counts, campaign terms, product sales, and account eligibility determine actual earnings.


### Side-by-Side Rate Math at 100,000 Monthly Views


The offers are not equivalent.[TikTok Creator Rewards](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/does-tiktok-pay-creators-creator-rewards-creator-fund-explained) requires 10,000 followers, and not every view qualifies. Claim’s rate is a campaign claim; check its current view-tracking and eligibility terms before treating the estimate as expected income. A flat fee or sales commission requires different inputs.


### Payout Methods, Minimums, and Timing: PayPal, Stripe, and App Wallets


Payment method, withdrawal minimum, and payout schedule vary by program and campaign. The research does not establish one verified minimum or timeline across the listed options, so check your account terms before accepting work. Confirm whether compensation is gross, when a post is approved, and what event starts the payment clock.


Keep records of the brief, post URL, approval status, attributed sales or qualifying views, and payment confirmation. ### Do Slideshows and Photo Posts Earn Money?


Payment depends on the program’s eligible format, not simply on views. TikTok Creator Rewards favors original videos longer than one minute with strong retention, so do not assume a slideshow or photo post qualifies for its video rewards. Check each campaign brief for accepted formats.


Affiliate content follows a separate path: a post can support product discovery, but commission depends on an attributed purchase and the applicable offer. Before making a slideshow for a paid brief, confirm the required format, approval criteria, and payment trigger in writing.
